pro_course_detail.title: English conversation topics (adjustable for level): student's choice!
pro_course_detail.description:
We'll discuss fun topics together, and you get to choose! The structure is similar to conversation practice for test preparation, but more relaxed.

Topics:
City/town - We will chat about life in towns and cities, including our own! In my case I have lived in Miami and all over Spain.

Movies/series - We will talk about the movies and series we love (or hate)! 

Music - We will discuss our favorite genres and our own experiences! Everything from concerts and festivals, to our own performances and how music is viewed in our cultures.

Books and short stories - What makes a good story? Our favorite stories and what they mean to us.

Art - What is art? We may converse about different types of art, the art we create, art in our lives, and philosophic questions such as: what is beauty? Is art subjective or objective? What is the purpose of art in a society?

Philosophy - Subjects ranging from free will, the mind, different philosophers, metaphysics, ethics, or anything else the student is interested in.

Science - We can talk about different scientific discoveries, advancements and what we can expect in the future, life on other planets.

Sleep/dreams - Everything from our sleeping patterns to lucid dreaming (controlling our own dreams, something I can do, and maybe I can teach you how to do it too!)

Food - The foods in our countries, foods we love and hate, rstaurants, cooking, different diets (like vegetarian or vegan), and all things food!

Anecdotes - These can be anything that's happened to us or someone we know. Could be anything  ranging from fun adventures, scary moments, broken bones, times we got in trouble, or just anything you would like to share. 

Goals - Our plans for the future, dream jobs, and where we want to end up. A great way to practice the future tense!

Student's suggestion! - We can talk about anything you'd like! Make a suggestions and we can discuss it.

Combination - Combine any of the topics above for a fun and dynamic conversation class!

course_info.trial_description:

An adult trial lesson runs like a conversation class, and a children's trial lesson will involve games and reading activities to get a better sense of the student's English abilities.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation Class
pro_course_detail.description: Let's improve your conversation skills!  This class will reinforce grammar and vocabulary through listening and speaking in a conversation.  You may pick the topic to be discussed, or I can offer some ideas.  Together, we will improve your English; I will give you corrections during and after the conversation, and at the end of the class I will give you a detailed conversation report that shows you the most common mistakes that you made during the class.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation & Grammar
pro_course_detail.description: Practice English speaking and grammar in a lesson customized just for you! We can focus on your grammar goals through the context of conversation, I will create a customized class that encourages you to use grammar in context.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Kids
pro_course_detail.description:
Language learning should be fun!  This lesson will reinforce grammar, vocabulary, and communication skills (reading, listening, speaking) in engaging ways that help young learners enjoy English class!

This class is intended for young English learners who need practice with verb tenses, simple sentences, and introductory vocabulary.  For more advanced learners, please look at my "Advanced English for Kids" class.

I've been teaching language primarily to kids and teens since I started teaching in 2012.  My classes are fun and engaging.  We will focus on vocabulary, grammar, and reading skills.

Please consider your student when booking a 60 minute class.  One hour is a long time to be engaged in an individual language lesson.  While we will have "brain breaks" and fun during class, prioritize your student when determining the best length of time for class.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English
pro_course_detail.description:
Preparing for an interview?  A presentation?  Or do you need to use English in your workplace?  I have experience Business English using Cambridge materials, and can help you learn the lingo, prepare for a specific situation, or be ready to speak on the phone with English-speaking colleagues.

Most of my business students work in engineering, accounting, travel and tourism, or banking.  Let me know your work sector before our class and I can personalize the lesson to you!

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced English for Kids
pro_course_detail.description:
Is your student ready for more? 

This class will run like an English Language Arts class, focused on reading literature and informational text, and writing about these texts.  We will reinforce grammar, vocabulary, and communication skills (reading, listening, speaking) through reading and writing, specifically focused on news, stories, and written work.  We will start with summarizing and storytelling, and move toward more advanced writing.

This class is intended for students who are ready to read higher-level texts and write longer tasks.  For beginning learners, please look at my "English for Kids" class.

I've been teaching language primarily to kids and teens since I started teaching in 2012.  My classes are fun and engaging, and are customized for each student.

Please consider your student when booking a 60 minute class.  One hour is a long time to be engaged in an individual language lesson.  While we will have "brain breaks" and fun during class, prioritize your student when determining the best length of time for class.

pro_course_detail.title: Writing Review
pro_course_detail.description:
Need an email or essay reviewed before sending or submitting?  I'm happy to look it over and provide helpful edits, feedback, and suggestions for improvement.
$8 for the first page, $5 for each additional page.  These will be booked as half hour increments.
30 minutes = $8, 1 page of writing
45 minutes = $13, 2 pages of writing
60 minutes = $18, 3 pages of writing
90 minutes = $23, 4 pages of writing

You can email your work to me to review, or we can review it together during a class session.

pro_course_detail.title: Introductory Spanish
pro_course_detail.description:
This is for students who are new to Spanish.  If you're looking for tutoring, please select "Spanish Tutoring."  For prepared lessons, look at "Spanish Lessons for Teens."

Are you looking to learn Spanish?  This is the perfect way to get started!  I've been teaching Spanish since 2012 and we will dive right in with vocabulary, readings, writings, listening, and speaking activities.

I use Comprehensible Input methodology to make sure students acquire language skills quickly in a fun, accessible way.  We'll use readings and videos to acquire language, and practice with writing and speaking activities.

In class, we will:
- learn new vocabulary through videos and readings
- break down grammar structures seen in authentic materials
- learn how to use Spanish in real-life situations

This is the perfect starting point for any student looking to learn Spanish from the beginning.

pro_course_detail.title: Spanish Support
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is for students already studying Spanish.  If you're looking to start studying, choose "Introductory Spanish."

If you're already studying Spanish for school and need some support, this is the place to start!  We will discuss your goals, and work together to be sure you're successful in your class.  We will use materials FROM YOUR CLASS to make sure you have a strong understanding of every concept.

Classes Include:
- vocabulary support
- grammar explanations and practice
- writing support
- review of learned concepts

*Students will receive support for concepts they're studying in another Spanish class.  This class is not intended to teach new material, but will instead support language studies.  There will be a class structure, but I will not prepare a lesson with new materials.

pro_course_detail.title: Spanish Conversation Class
pro_course_detail.description: Looking to practice your Spanish with a structured conversation?  In this class, we'll discuss specific themes in Spanish and support your language use with key vocabulary and pop-up grammar.  This is not a structured lesson, but is a conversation and opportunity to practice.
